1 published version of [Watch your website being built: a brief for a page that builds a first version of a sovereign website in the visitor's own browser, from a description or a voice note, with their own model key, showing every agent at work, every behaviour policy being applied and every penny it costs, then hands back a zip, the same brief run on several models side by side as evals, and the Web Summit demos it grows from](../watch-your-website-being-built.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
